subject: PLAN: Taste-Bench back as E7; Track S = Marius Hobbhahn; user models in past.dev
body: Pushed 5e0201c. (1) Taste-Bench research subset (wbopan/tastebench, 112 forks) is the research-taste benchmark again: new experiment E7 in PLAN section 9, scorer in autoresearch/taste/tastebench.py (paired_order_v1: a fork counts only if right in both option orders). No run yet; the data is gated and every run needs Ethan's approval. (2) Both taste tracks are required. Track S is Marius Hobbhahn (consent not asked yet). Track P is still open and it is not Ethan. (3) Every fitted usermodel.json can be pushed to shared memory (past.dev when PAST_API_KEY is set): python3 -m autoresearch.taste.usermodel_store push or pull --researcher SLUG.
